```yaml
name: TypeScript Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd fern
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run preview
        run: |
          cd fern
          pnpm run preview

      - name: Verify header is hidden
        run: |
          if grep -q "x-session-access-key" fern/docs; then
            echo "Header x-session-access-key found in docs. Failing."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Header x-session-access-key not found. Success."
          fi
```
